search_text.text:
Detail of 1920 Bartholomew map with overlays showing the course
  of Bloom's walk in Lestrygonians (blue), Lemon's candy store
  (red), Burton's restaurant (orange), Davy Byrne's pub (green),
  and the National Museum (purple).
